title: A 60GHz Outphasing Transmitter in 40nm CMOS with 15.6dBm Output Power Dixian Zhao, Shailesh Kulkarni, Patrick Reynaert
figure_number: Fig. 9.5.4, the primary side of the combiner has two pairs of differential ports excited by outphasing signals while the center taps provide DC access. The unwanted magnetic coupling of adjacent windings is minimized by orthogonal placement of the two coils. This combiner has a -1dB BW of 20GHz which guarantees correct outphasing operation.
